mono-0419.d: Stippled grain cloud, hand-set dots gathering into separate masses, light and airy. Vibrates gently when you walk.

mono-0446.d: One-point perspective corridor, a few frames receding into the distance, rays packed tight. Grid discipline, worn casually.

mono-0472.d: Dense concentric octagons, twisting slowly inward. Quiet from a distance, sharp up close.

mono-0474.d: Dot-matrix ring on a chunky LED grid. Busy up close, calm at a distance.

mono-0492.d: Dense concentric hexagons, twisting slowly inward. Pure form, no explanation needed.
